messages:
maria: OK team — goal for today: lock down the "error handshake" contract we ship with the API. Specifically we need a small, stable set of top-level fields clients can rely on (across chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) so SDKs and platform tooling behave consistently. I sketched a proposal below.

jon: +1. We must avoid breaking existing clients. Additive fields only; and clear guidance for 'retry' semantics.

maria: Proposal (minimal): 
```
{
  "code": "string",        // machine token, e.g. RATE_LIMIT, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, VALIDATION_ERROR
  "http_status": 429,       // numeric
  "message": "string",    // human-friendly short message
  "retryable": true|false,  // boolean hint for automated clients
  "retry_after": "secs",  // optional numeric seconds when applicable
  "request_id": "string", // for tracing
  "details": [ ... ]       // optional array of key/value strings for diagnostic metadata
}
```
This should cover most cases.

ryan: A couple of infra notes: please include header parity for rate limits: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset and also set Retry-After on 429/503. For model-unavailable we should include an optional "fallback_model" field (string) when an automated fallback is safe. That keeps client routing simple.

sarah: For observability, require request_id on every error. We should also standardize the 'code' vocabulary — start with RATE_LIMIT, VALIDATION_ERROR, AUTH_INVALID, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR, QUOTA_EXCEEDED. Docs must map those to retry semantics.

leo_sdk: SDK note: we'll auto-handle three classes by default: 
- retryable transient (ex: 429, 503, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE with retryable=true) with exponential backoff using Retry-After when present;
- non-retryable client errors (4xx like validation) surface immediately;
- idempotency only for specific endpoints.
Snippet for JS client (draft):
```
//  simplified
if (err.retryable) {
  const wait = err.retry_after ? err.retry_after*1000 : backoff.next()
  await sleep(wait)
  return retry()
}
throw err
```
We need field names stable so SDKs don't ship feature flags for parsing.

jon: Launch criteria (product ask):
- Spec published in docs and example responses for each endpoint (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank, function-calls).
- SDKs (js/py) implement default handling for retryable and surface raw envelope for advanced users.
- E2E tests covering: rate-limit header presence, retry_after respect, streaming interruption with terminal error, and fallback_model suggestions.

ryan: Streaming edge-case: if a stream is cut due to model unavailable we should emit a final structured event frame so clients can detect it (instead of silent TCP close). Proposal format for SSE/websocket lines: 
```
:event
{ "event_type": "error", "code": "MODEL_UNAVAILABLE", "message": "fallback suggested", "fallback_model": "redwood-medium-1" }
```
That way streaming parsers can route to error handlers.

maria: Good. Also negotiation note: some customers asked for granular rate-limit codes (per-resource quotas). We can add a namespaced code like RATE_LIMIT:DEDICATED_POOL or provide details in the "details" array. Prefer details to exploding the enum.

sarah: Security/legal: ensure messages do not leak internal model names or infra reasons. "fallback_model" can be a stable public alias (not internal hostnames). We'll add a short compliance checklist for responses.

jon: For validation errors we should standardize a 422 for schema validation vs 400 for malformed requests. Include a small example: 
```
{
  "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  "http_status": 422,
  "message": "Missing required field: input[]",
  "details": [{"field":"input","error":"required"}]
}
```
SDKs will map 422 -> ValidationError type.

leo_sdk: We'll also add a developer-mode passthrough so advanced users can opt into raw error payloads. Important for customers building custom logic.

maria: Action items / owners: 
- api-spec PR with canonical enum + example envelopes: @jon (owner) — due EOW.
- streaming error envelope impl + tests: @ryan (owner) — due next Tues.
- SDK update + docs: @leo_sdk (owner) — draft by next Thurs.
- Compliance check for messages: @sarah (owner) — in parallel.

prod-bot: Deployed staging schema validator job created (run id: sv-2026-32). :robot_face: 

maria: Thanks all — if anyone objects to the minimal field set above, speak now. Otherwise I'll make the PR and link the draft spec here. :+1:
